package emissionfixture

// A synthetic provider whose fields are written BOTH ways: two in the map
// literal and two afterwards. It exists so the emission collector is tested
// against the shape round 3 found it blind to, without adding a fake
// provider to the shipped package.

type SyntheticProvider struct{}

func (p *SyntheticProvider) Capability() contextfabric.FactCapability {
	return newCapability(contextfabric.FactSynthetic, "devhealthfacts.synthetic", nil)
}

func (p *SyntheticProvider) Read() {
	fields := map[string]contextfabric.FactValue{
		"in_literal_one": nil,
		"in_literal_two": nil,
	}
	fields["written_after_init"] = nil
	if true {
		fields["written_in_a_branch"] = nil
	}
	_ = fields
}
